translation.en: The road is long.
The traveller took the road.
The man walked on the road.
We reached the end of the road.
The family arrived at the airport.
The student visited the family.
The traveller longed for the family.
The family home is warm.
The example is clear.
The teacher gave an example.

translation.bs: Učenik je razumio lekciju kroz primjere.
translation.en: The student understood the lesson through examples.
The meaning of the proverb is easy.
The father works a lot.
The doctor visited the sick father.
The child sat with the father.
The father's house is large.
The polytheist worships idols.

translation.bs: Putnik je sreo mnogobošce na ostrvu.
translation.en: The traveler met polytheists on the island.
The historian wrote about the polytheists.
The polytheists' idols are many.
The judgment is just.
The judge issued the judgment.

translation.bs: Advokat je uložio prigovor na presudu.
translation.en: The lawyer objected to the judgment.
The text of the judgment is long.
Fear is natural.
The hero does not know fear.
The child cried from fear.
The reason for the fear is unknown.
The male safeguards the nest.
The cow gave birth to a male.
The female searches for the male.
The male's size is large.
The leg is sound.
The doctor treated the leg.

translation.bs: Dijete je stajalo na jednoj nozi.
translation.en: The child stood on one leg.
The pain of the leg is severe.
The faithful companion is rare.
The traveler waited for the companion.
The man traveled with the companion.
The companion's house is near.
Corruption harms the country.
The government fought corruption.
The journalist wrote about corruption.
The danger of corruption is great.
The benefit is great.
The rain brought benefit to the farmers.
The merchant thought about the benefit.
The amount of the benefit is small.
Effort is the road to success.
The teacher appreciated the effort.
The team succeeded through effort.
The fruit of effort is sweet.
Evening came.
The poet loved the evening.
The farmer worked until the evening.
The evening breeze is cool.
The parents were glad about the success.
The young man visited the parents.
The daughter purchased a gift for the parents.
The love of the parents is great.
The pilgrimage is a long journey.
The grandfather performed the pilgrimage.
The neighbor returned from the pilgrimage.
The season of the pilgrimage is near.
Fear filled his heart.
The soldier hid the fear.
The child was silent from fear.
The cause of the fear is unknown.
The heel of the foot is swollen.
The shoe wounded the heel.

translation.bs: Doktor je stavio zavoj na petu.
translation.en: The doctor put a bandage on the heel.
The skin of the heel is dry.
A righteous companion is a blessing.
The young man chose an upright companion.

translation.bs: Trgovac je putovao s čestitim pratiocem.
translation.en: The merchant traveled with a righteous companion.
The morals of the righteous companion are good.
The qiblah is in this direction.
The traveler determined the qiblah.
The man turned to the qiblah.
The direction of the qiblah is clear.
Tranquility filled the house.

translation.bs: Putnik je pronašao smirenost u selu.
translation.en: The traveler found tranquillity in the village.
The mother spoke with tranquillity.
The moment of tranquillity is beautiful.
The merchandise arrived at the store.
The merchant sold the merchandise.
The storehouse filled with merchandise.
The quality of the merchandise is high.
The fruit matured.
The farmer harvested the fruit.
The basket filled with fruit.
The taste of the fruit is sweet.
The teacher's position is high.
People respected the grandfather's position.
The writer reached a high position.

translation.bs: Ljubav prema položaju je loša osobina.
translation.en: Love of position is a bad characteristic.
A human being's capability is limited.
This is not within the child's capability.
The answer was correct.
The student wrote the answer.
The student searched for the answer.
The speed of the answer amazed the teacher.

translation.bs: Odmazda je važna tema u pravu.
translation.en: Retaliation is an important subject in law.
The students studied retaliation.
The judge spoke about retaliation.
The law of retaliation is old.
The heat is intense today.
The children hate the heat.
People flee from the heat.
The intensity of the heat is tiring.
The calculation was precise.
The teacher examined the calculation.
The precision of the calculation is important.
The debris was in the road.
The workers gathered the debris.

translation.bs: Susjedi su očistili ulicu od krša.
translation.en: The neighbors cleaned the street of the debris.
The heap of debris is large.
The foundations of the building were strong.
The engineer examined the foundations of the building.
The building stands on strong foundations.
The building of the foundations is difficult.
The time passed quickly.
The student forgot the time.
The teacher spoke about time.
The value of time is great.

translation.bs: Žalost se pojavila na njegovom licu.
translation.en: Sorrow appeared on his face.
The student showed great sorrow.
The girl felt sorrow.
The reason for the sorrow is clear.
Coercion is injustice.
The worker rejected coercion.

translation.bs: Čovjek je potpisao ugovor pod prisilom.
translation.en: The man signed the contract under coercion.
The effects of coercion are bad.
The thunder is strong at night.
The children heard the thunder.
The cat was afraid of the thunder.
The sound of the thunder awakened the child.
The orbit of the moon is around the earth.
The students studied the orbit of the planet.

translation.bs: Učitelj je govorio o putanji zemlje.
translation.en: The teacher spoke about the orbit of the earth.

translation.bs: Učenik je nacrtao oblik putanje zemlje.
translation.en: The student sketched the form of the earth's orbit.
